info.title: Digital Corporate Gift Card Platform
info.description: Multi-tenant gift-card platform with identity, authorization, audit, and ledger-backed corporate credit.

get.summary: Returns permission-protected tenant audit history.
get.description: Requires organization.audit.view or platform.audit.view. Supports exact operation, outcome, and correlation filters.

post.summary: Exchanges an email or phone number and password for an access and refresh token.
Rotates a refresh token and issues a new token pair.
Revokes the session identified by a refresh token.
Creates the first platform administrator exactly once.
Assigns the first Company Administrator to a root organization.
Allocates corporate credit through the immutable ledger.
post.description: Requires platform.corporate_credits.allocate. Identical retries return the original allocation.

post.summary: Reverses one corporate-credit allocation through a compensating ledger transaction.
post.description: Requires platform.corporate_credits.reverse. The original allocation remains immutable.

get.summary: Returns ledger-derived corporate-credit balances.
Returns immutable corporate-credit allocation history.
get.description: Requires platform.corporate_credits.view or organization.corporate_credits.view. Uses a stable opaque cursor with a limit from 1 to 200.

get.summary: Returns the authenticated identity and selected authority context.
get.description: Without X-Organization-Id, returns identity or platform context. With a verified organization header, returns that membership and its effective permissions against the exact selected organization.

get.summary: Lists organizations selectable by the authenticated user.
get.description: Exact-user, active-membership discovery. Call without X-Organization-Id; the returned membership is not proof of authority until selected and verified.

get.summary: Returns the Development claim delivery captured for the demo.
Returns the captured Development direct-share delivery.

post.summary: Claims and activates a delivered gift card.
post.description: The invitation selects email or phone as the recipient login identifier. A password is required only when the verified contact has no existing identity.

post.summary: Sends one inventory card to an email or phone recipient.
post.description: Creates a single-use invitation and changes ownership to AwaitingClaim. No ledger value moves during this ownership-only operation.

post.summary: Issues and distributes 1–100 cards atomically.
post.description: The synchronous operation requires both issue and distribute permissions. All card, Ledger, invitation, audit, and batch rows commit together or all roll back.

get.summary: Returns one durable bulk issuance/distribution result.

post.summary: Durably accepts up to 2,000 gift-card rows for background processing.
post.description: Requires both issue and distribute permissions. Every normalized row is persisted before the Pending response; corporate credit is consumed per row.

get.summary: Returns paginated per-row outcomes for an asynchronous batch.

post.summary: Creates an idempotent child batch containing only failed rows.

get.summary: Returns rebuildable per-currency Phase 2 totals.
get.description: Requires both corporate-credit and gift-card view authority. Every amount is derived from authoritative domain and Ledger records.

get.summary: Returns a stable cross-operation financial timeline.
get.description: Supports exact category, operation, and currency filters; literal case-insensitive business/public reference search; and an inclusive UTC start with an exclusive UTC end.

get.summary: Lists every gift card the organization has funded.
get.description: Distinct from gift-card inventory, which shows only cards still in organization ownership and therefore loses sight of a card once it reaches its recipient. Reports the funded amount rather than the remaining balance for a card an identity already owns, and masks the recipient contact (ADR-052).

get.summary: Compares authoritative financial and sharing records with Ledger postings.
get.description: Read-only: findings cover corporate credit, card funding/lifecycle, active share reservations, transfers, and child lineage. The operation never mutates or repairs history.

post.summary: Issues a ledger-funded card into organization inventory.
post.description: Requires organization.gift_cards.issue for the target organization. The public reference is for display and support only; it is never a payment credential.

get.summary: Returns organization-owned gift-card inventory.
get.description: Requires organization.gift_cards.view for the target organization. Uses a stable opaque cursor with a limit from 1 to 200.

post.summary: Creates a user account.
Disables a user and revokes all active sessions.
Creates a membership in the caller's organization.
post.description: Requires the organization.memberships.create permission. The organization is taken from the route and must be covered by the verified membership's scope. The membership and its append-only audit record are committed atomically. Exactly one existing-user selector is required: userId remains supported for compatibility, while email is resolved only after authorization.

get.summary: Lists memberships for an organization.
get.description: An organization-scoped caller requires organization.memberships.view over the exact target. A platform operator may read any organization through the controlled RLS path (platform.organizations.memberships.view). Paged via limit (1-200, default 50) and offset.

post.summary: Disables a membership in an authorized organization.
post.description: Requires the organization.memberships.disable permission.

get.summary: Lists the signed-in recipient's currently owned cards and balances.
Returns one owned card with its Ledger-derived balance.
Returns an owned card's transaction and lifecycle history.

post.summary: Creates a root customer organization.
post.description: Requires the platform.organizations.create permission. The organization and its append-only audit record are committed atomically.

get.summary: Lists root customer organizations for a platform operator.
get.description: Requires platform.organizations.view. Supports bounded offset paging, literal case-insensitive name/code search, and exact status filtering.

get.summary: Reads a single organization.

post.summary: Registers an e-pin reseller against a funding root organization.
post.description: The organization must be an active root. Its prepaid corporate credit funds every card the partner mints, which is the ceiling on what a compromised credential can ever produce.

get.summary: Lists registered e-pin resellers.

post.summary: Registers an API client belonging to a partner.
post.description: Returns the client secret once. Only its hash is stored, so the secret cannot be recovered afterwards and a lost one is replaced by registering another client and disabling the old one.

get.summary: Lists a partner's API clients. Secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Disables one API client. Takes effect on the next request.
post.description: The usual response to a suspected leak: the reseller keeps trading on its other keys. E-pins already sold stay claimable, because they belong to the reseller's buyers; voiding those is a separate clawback action.

post.summary: Disables a whole reseller. Takes effect on the next request.
Exchanges partner API client credentials for a short-lived access token.
post.description: Unknown clients, disabled clients, disabled partners, and wrong secrets are refused identically and in constant time. The token identifies the client only; the funding organization is resolved server-side on every request, so disabling a client or partner takes effect immediately rather than at expiry.

post.summary: Mints a gift card against the reseller's prepaid float.
post.description: The funding and issuing organization come from the authenticated partner principal and cannot be supplied by the caller. The response returns the buyer claim URL and PIN and must never be cached or logged.

post.summary: Issues a short-lived payment credential for an owned gift card.
post.description: Returns a 256-bit opaque credential once, valid for 60 seconds against the server clock. The value it authorises is resolved by server-side lookup; the credential itself carries no card, owner, amount, or balance.

get.summary: Returns the exact card owner's checkout outcome.
get.description: Returns pending, active, confirmed, cancelled, or expired state without returning or accepting the payment credential.

post.summary: Reads what a presented card can spend, reserving nothing.
post.description: Answers the question a cashier is asked before splitting a tender. Requires a live presented credential, so it cannot be used to sweep balances, and deliberately does not consume it, so asking does not cost the customer the code they are about to pay with. Returns the amount spendable now, which excludes value held by a share or another till. Unknown, expired, and consumed credentials are refused identically. It is a POST because the credential travels in the body: a query string would put a payment credential into logs and history.

post.summary: Reserves card value for a sale in progress.
post.description: Consumes the presented payment credential exactly once and holds the amount for two minutes. Nothing is posted to the Ledger; confirmation is a separate operation. Unknown, replayed, and expired credentials are refused identically.

get.summary: Reads a hold created by the calling POS client.

post.summary: Releases an active hold. Posts nothing to the Ledger.
Confirms one hold and posts the redemption exactly once.
post.description: Charges the explicitly stated positive amount up to the held ceiling, releases any remainder, and atomically records the balanced Ledger redemption. Safe retries return the original outcome.

post.summary: Appends a partial or full refund to a confirmed redemption.
post.description: Supports multiple immutable partial refunds up to the confirmed amount. The original POS client may refund from any of its active terminals; safe retries use an idempotency key.

post.summary: Registers a point-of-sale integration.
post.description: Returns the client secret once. Only its hash is stored, so the secret cannot be recovered afterwards and must be re-registered if lost.

get.summary: Lists registered point-of-sale integrations.

post.summary: Permanently retires a point-of-sale integration.
post.description: New device-token exchanges and already-issued device tokens are refused on their next API request.

post.summary: Registers a till belonging to a point-of-sale integration.

get.summary: Lists tills belonging to a point-of-sale integration.

post.summary: Permanently retires one till.
post.description: Sibling tills remain active. New device-token exchanges are refused immediately, and an already-issued device token is refused on its next API request.

post.summary: Exchanges POS client credentials and a terminal code for an access token.
post.description: Unknown, disabled, and wrong credentials are refused identically. The token identifies the till only; it is not authority to charge any particular card, which additionally requires a payment credential.

get.summary: Searches cross-tenant store, terminal, receipt, payment, and refund activity.
get.description: Requires platform.payments.view. Totals are derived from authoritative payment provisions and immutable refunds; fully refunded payments are reversals.

get.summary: Returns one payment receipt with its immutable refund lines.

post.summary: Creates a role in an authorized organization.
post.description: Requires the role.create permission. A role belongs to exactly one organization and carries no scope of its own — scope lives on the assignment (ADR-006).

get.summary: Lists roles in an authorized organization.

post.summary: Grants permissions to a role.
post.description: Requires the role.manage_permissions permission. Only organization permissions the caller itself holds may be granted, and only names present in the catalogue.

post.summary: Assigns a role to a membership within a scope.
post.description: Requires the role.assign permission. A role from one organization can never be assigned to a membership in another.

get.summary: Lists role assignments in an authorized organization.
get.description: Requires the role.view permission. Results are scoped to the exact organization and ordered by creation time with a stable identifier tie breaker.

post.summary: Reserves part of an owned card and creates a protected share link.
post.description: Returns the raw claim URL and six-digit PIN once. The Ledger transfer does not post until a recipient claims the share.

get.summary: Lists shares sent or received by the signed-in cardholder.

post.summary: Cancels an unclaimed share and releases its reservation.
Claims a PIN-protected share into the signed-in recipient account.
post.description: The caller must already be authenticated. Claim atomically creates a separate child card and posts the balanced source-to-child Ledger transfer.

post.summary: Reserves card value and sends a contact-bound share invitation.
post.description: Commits the reservation before notification delivery. The response and audit expose only the masked recipient contact.

post.summary: Claims a verified email or phone share invitation.
post.description: Creates the minimum recipient identity only when the verified contact is new. Existing identities continue through normal login.

post.summary: Creates a subsidiary beneath the caller's organization.
post.description: Requires the organization.create_subsidiary permission. The parent is the caller's active organization, not a request-body value. Enforces the configured maximum hierarchy depth. The subsidiary and its append-only audit record are committed atomically.

get.summary: Lists the direct subsidiaries of the caller's organization.
get.description: Requires the organization.view permission. Paged via limit (1-200, default 50) and offset.

Bearer.description: JWT access token returned by POST /api/v1/auth/login or /refresh.
